subject: Shit To Do in NYC (Oct 12): Navy Yard car show, House of Yes Rocky Horror
opener: Halloween season has officially taken over the calendar, which means the weird stuff is finally outnumbering the normal stuff. This week you get 120 cars in a Navy Yard warehouse, a live Rocky Horror with drag and aerial work, and a 60-seat Arabic music premiere nobody you know has heard of. Pick two and you've had a good week.

picks.headline: 120 cars in a Navy Yard warehouse
picks.title: Wheels of NYC Car Show — Fall Edition
picks.when: Sat Oct 17, doors noon, runs through the afternoon
picks.why: This is the Daikoku-style thing you said you wanted more of, and it's a ten-minute walk from your door. Sixty thousand square feet of old Navy Yard warehouse, 120-plus classics and JDM builds, music and food, no corny cruise-in energy. Flat floor, daytime, so the kid rides along in the carrier and stares at engines if you'd rather do it as a family thing than a guys thing.
picks.heads_up: Tickets from about $50 on Dice, doors at noon. Buy before Saturday rather than at the door, and go early if you want to actually hear yourself talk near the cars.
picks.invite_text: Saturday afternoon there's a 120-car show in a warehouse at the Navy Yard, ten minutes from me. Come through around noon and we'll walk over.

verification.note: Dice blocked fetching, but the organizer's own events page (wheelsof.com) and the Posh ticket page both state Sat Oct 17, 2026, 12:00pm–6:00pm at Agger Fish Warehouse, Brooklyn Navy Yard; Dice listing shows 'From $49.86', matching the ~$50 figure.

picks.headline: Rocky Horror, live cast, House of Yes
picks.title: LIPS: Rocky Horror LIVE at House of Yes
picks.when: Thu Oct 15 to Fri Oct 16, doors 6:30pm, show 7:15pm; seating not guaranteed after 7:30pm
picks.price: from about $58 general admission; cabaret tables cost more
picks.why: You dressed up for Rocky Horror in Flatbush and loved it. This is not a screening with a shadow cast, it's House of Yes's resident crew doing their own version with drag, burlesque and aerial. Thursday and Friday are both on, and Friday works as the date night if you can get the sitter.
picks.heads_up: About $58 general admission, cabaret tables cost more. Doors 6:30, show 7:15, and seating is not guaranteed after 7:30, so get there early. Costume is welcome and you'll feel underdressed without one.
picks.invite_text: House of Yes is doing their own live Rocky Horror Thursday and Friday, drag and aerial, not a movie. Want to do the Friday one? I'll get the sitter sorted.

verification.note: House of Yes calendar event page states Thursday, October 15, 2026, doors 6:30pm, show 7:15pm, seating not guaranteed after 7:30pm, at House of Yes; the Shotgun venue listing prices this date at $57.75, not about $52.

picks.headline: Razor-N-Tape album night at Public Records
picks.title: Razor-N-Tape presents "A Joyful Noise" — Live From Public Records album release show
picks.why: Label-run house night in the Sound Room, which holds about 150 people and has the best sound system in Gowanus. This is the Public Records register you like: no guest list theater, just a room built for listening with people who actually dance. Thursday is your slot and it's fifteen minutes from home.
picks.heads_up: $27, doors 8pm. Set times weren't posted, so check the venue page the day of if you want to time your arrival. Date corrected: this is Thursday Oct 15, this week — not Oct 23.
picks.invite_text: Thursday there's a Razor-N-Tape release party at Public Records, 150-cap room with the big sound system. Doors at 8, tickets are cheap. You in?

verification.note: The RA link in the listing (ra.co/events/2532351) is a different Public Records party (P.E.A.R.L./Juana, Fri Oct 23); the Razor-N-Tape 'A Joyful Noise – Live From Public Records' album release show is listed by Public Records on Dice with event data showing start 2026-10-15 20:00, doors 8:00 PM, 233 Butler St, $26.78, 21+.

picks.headline: New Arabic maqam compositions, 60-seat back room
picks.title: Brooklyn Maqam presents The Maqamposers Club
picks.price: cover collected at the door; amount not listed on the calendar
picks.why: Five serious players, brand-new instrumental pieces written in Arabic maqam, in the Barbès back room that holds maybe sixty people. Ney, qanun, oud, violin, percussion, no marketing budget, community-run. This is the exact thing you mean when you say you want the scene you had to know someone to hear about. Yes, it's a Wednesday. It's a one-night thing and it's worth breaking the rule.
picks.heads_up: 7pm, cover collected at the door and the amount isn't posted. Bring cash, show up 20 minutes early or you'll be standing behind the bar crowd.
picks.invite_text: Wednesday at 7 there's a one-off night of new Arabic maqam compositions in the back room at Barbes, sixty seats. Early enough to still be a normal weeknight. In?

verification.note: Barbès' October 2026 PDF calendar (linked from their events page) lists Wednesday 14 at 7pm, Brooklyn Maqam Presents: The Maqamposers Club, with no admission price printed for that show.

picks.headline: Gethard works out an hour at Union Hall
picks.title: Chris Gethard and Dave Ross Leave For Fest
picks.why: Union Hall's basement is about 150 seats and you're ten feet from the comic, which is the closest thing in Brooklyn to that Midtown apartment show you loved. Gethard and Dave Ross are banging on festival material, so it's the raw version, not the polished one. 7:30 start means drinks after and you're still home at a dad hour.
picks.heads_up: Small room and a name attached, so it will sell out. Buy now, not Saturday afternoon. Bocce and a bar upstairs for after.
picks.invite_text: Gethard is working out new material in the Union Hall basement Saturday at 7:30, 150 seats. Grabbing tickets tonight, you want one?

verification.note: Eventbrite listing (organizer Union Hall) states Saturday, October 17, 2026, 7:30 PM show with 7 PM doors at Union Hall, 702 Union St.; Union Hall's own calendar shows the same Oct 17 7:30pm listing.

picks.headline: Reggae Rewind takes Littlefield till 4am
picks.title: REGGAE REWIND — Fall Edition
picks.when: Sat Oct 17 to Sun Oct 18, 11pm to 4am
picks.why: Popcaan, Sean Paul, Gyptian are all over your library and this is the Brooklyn party version of that, not a club with a guest list. Selectors playing reggae and dancehall in a proper Gowanus warehouse room, 21+, no listicle crowd. It doesn't get good until well after midnight, so file it under sometimes.
picks.heads_up: 11pm doors, runs to 4am. This is the late one of the week, so don't stack it on top of an early Saturday with the kid.
picks.invite_text: Saturday night there's a reggae and dancehall party at Littlefield that runs till 4. Doesn't get going till midnight, so nap first and meet me there at 11:30.

verification.note: littlefield's own event page shows REGGAE REWIND — Fall Edition on Saturday, October 17, 2026, 11:00pm–4:00am, 21+, at 635 Sackett St, with tickets listed at $18.71–$29.50 and $25 cash at the door.

picks.headline: Open House New York unlocks 300 buildings
picks.title: Open House New York Weekend 2026
picks.when: Fri Oct 16 to Sun Oct 18, roughly 10am to 6pm Friday through Sunday, varies by site
picks.venue: Open House New York (300+ sites citywide)
picks.price: free at most sites; some reservation-only tours are ticketed
picks.why: One weekend a year the city opens the doors it normally keeps shut: power plants, water infrastructure, private houses, workshops. Most of it is free and walk-up, and a lot of the good Brooklyn sites are a bike ride from Fort Greene. Build a loop with one friend, or do a couple of stops with the stroller in the morning.
picks.heads_up: The best sites are reservation-only and those went live October 2, so assume the marquee tours are gone. Walk-up sites are the play. Check the map Friday morning and plan a route instead of wandering.
picks.invite_text: Open House New York is this weekend, a few hundred buildings open that are normally locked. Want to bike a Brooklyn loop Saturday morning and hit four or five?

verification.note: OHNY's own activity page lists October 16, 17 and 18, 2026, each 10 AM–6 PM, roughly 300 citywide sites, most free with some ticketed/reservation-only access.

radar.title: hABBAween

radar.headline: City of Gods, two nights at Industry City
radar.title: City of Gods Halloween Festival 2026
radar.when: Fri Oct 23 to Sat Oct 24, doors 9pm, runs to about 5am both nights
radar.venue: City of Gods Festival at Industry City
radar.why: House of Yes takes over Industry City for their eighth Halloween: multiple stages, real production, costumes required for entry, which keeps the bottle-service crowd out. The melodic house and techno rooms are the reason to go. It runs to 5am, so it's a once-a-year night.
radar.book_by: Single-night and two-day passes now; Friday Oct 23 and Saturday Oct 24 both sell out

verification.note: House of Yes calendar event page confirms City of Gods Halloween Festival 2026, Friday, October 23, 2026, doors 9:00 PM, two nights at Industry City (alcohol service until 4AM), single-night and 2-day passes available.

radar.headline: Brett Goldstein's raw hour, Bell House
radar.title: Brett Goldstein Runs His Hour Before His Tour
radar.why: He'll be playing theaters with this material in a few months. Wednesday Oct 21 he's doing the unpolished version in a 300-person Gowanus room. That asymmetry is the whole point.
radar.book_by: On sale now and it will go fast; buy this week

verification.note: The Bell House's own calendar lists Brett Goldstein Runs His Hour Before His Tour on Wed Oct 21, 2026 at 7:30PM with the matching Ticketmaster link.

radar.headline: NYCB Nutcracker tickets are already up
radar.title: George Balanchine's The Nutcracker — New York City Ballet
radar.when: Fri Nov 27 to Sat Jan 2, matinee and evening performances through the run
radar.why: You've said this is the best thing you've done in the city, and Tchaikovsky is sitting in your library. The run is Nov 27 through Jan 2 and the good December Saturdays vanish by Halloween.
radar.book_by: Book in October; prime weekend evenings go first

verification.note: NYCB's own Nutcracker program page states Nov 27, 2026–Jan 02, 2027, approx. 2 hrs, at the David H. Koch Theater, with page metadata giving an 8:00 PM start on Nov 27.

anytime.headline: Bathhouse Williamsburg added a banya and a rooftop pool
anytime.title: Bathhouse Williamsburg — rooftop pool, banya and Event Sauna
anytime.price: day pass from $39; memberships $145/month (3 passes, $48 each) or $225/month (5 passes, $45 each)
anytime.why: You already know the place, but the Russian banya, the new Event Sauna with Aufguss and the rooftop pool are all new this year, which makes it a plan rather than a repeat. Day passes start at $39, and there are monthly memberships if it becomes a habit. Stack it after a session at Kings Combat and it's a whole Saturday with one friend.
anytime.heads_up: Membership pricing has changed: there is no $40 weekday 'Select' rate any more, though day passes still start at $39.

verification.note: Bathhouse's Williamsburg page confirms the venue (103 N 10th St), rooftop pool, banya and Event Sauna, and 'Day Pass, Starts at $39', but the memberships page now only offers Starter $145/mo and Standard $225/mo, not a Select $40/$65 per-session plan.

anytime.headline: Half-price tarot readings at Theatre XIV
anytime.title: Diva Divination at Théâtre XIV (half off in October)
anytime.when: Mon Oct 12 to Sat Oct 31, by appointment, before or around showtime
anytime.price: half off in October with promo code DIVINE50
anytime.why: Company XIV runs tarot and lipstick readings by appointment at the Bushwick theater, and they're half off through October with the code. It's the ten-dollar idea that turns a night out there into something you clearly planned. Book the appointment for the same evening as whatever you're seeing.

verification.note: Company XIV's divination page confirms Diva Divination (French Kiss lipstick and tarot readings) by appointment at Théâtre XIV with promo code DIVINE50 for 50% off through October 31, 2026; it is an ongoing October offer, must be booked online in advance (no walk-ups), and no dollar prices are published.

family.headline: 400 artists open their Gowanus studios, free
family.title: Gowanus Open Studios 2026 (30th anniversary)
family.when: Sat Oct 17 to Sun Oct 18, daytime both days; most studios open midday to early evening
family.address: Multiple studios around Gowanus, Park Slope and Carroll Gardens
family.why: Thirtieth year of Gowanus Open Studios: ninety-odd buildings, free, self-guided, and several studios throw actual beer-and-music open houses instead of polite gallery hours. It's the neighborhood-scale version of that photo studio party you loved. Stroller-friendly, you set the pace, and you can be home for the nap.
family.invite_text: Gowanus Open Studios is Saturday and Sunday, hundreds of artists open their actual studios and it's free. Want to do a couple of hours Saturday morning with the stroller and get lunch after?

verification.note: The artsgowanus.org event URL supplied is a stale 2024 page (Oct 19–20, 2024); Brownstoner's Oct 12, 2026 article settles it: the 30th annual Gowanus Open Studios is Saturday and Sunday, October 17–18, 2026, noon–6pm, free, across 90+ locations.

notes: The fights and food lanes came back empty this week, so there's no card and no chef takeover to give you. The one piece of good news since the first draft: the Razor-N-Tape night at Public Records turned out to be this Thursday, not next week, so the music slot got filled after all. The music and fights and food research lanes failed this week, so that side is thin.
